newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Tx. power unit out to end Oct.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Tx. power unit out to end Oct.

text.p: Southwestern Public Service Co's 565 megawatt (MW) Tolk coal-fired power unit 1 was expected to be out of service until the end of October for scheduled maintenance, a company spokesman said.
"We expect it will be back up at the end of the month," company spokesman Ken Vaughn said Tuesday.
The unit, located near Muleshoe in the Texas panhandle, was shut Oct 4 for the maintenance.
The Tolk coal unit 2, also with a capacity of 565 MW, was operating normally at full output, Vaughn said.
